text:
Maya: PTAL — addressed @Sam's comments about metrics tagging and the SDK hook ordering. Added a tiny migration that renames metric keys to metrics_v2 and left an alias for the old keys for 7 days. Ran unit tests + quick integ smoke locally. Diff: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/1234/files

Sam: Looks a lot cleaner, thanks. Two tiny nits inline (naming + log level). PTAL at my comments? Otherwise happy to approve once those are addressed.

Alex: Quick sanity check — will this change surface in dashboards or require backfill for analytics? If so we should lock the window and notify analytics.

Maya: Good question — no backfill required. Keys map 1:1 and alias covers reads; added note in the runbook and PR description.

Jessie: Smoke steps I used (staging):
```bash
./scripts/smoke_metrics.sh --env=staging
tail -f /var/log/redwood/metrics.log | grep mysvc
```
Added those commands to the PR description under "how to smoke test".

Ryan: I can take merge custody for the 16:00 UTC slot today. Will run the staging smoke then promote canary if green. @deploy-bot can you reserve the slot? :clock4:

deploy-bot: Reserved canary slot 2024-04-12 16:00 UTC for @Ryan. Reminder will fire 15m prior.

Maya: Thanks all — addressed Sam's two nits and squashed. Re-requesting review @Sam @Alex PTAL when you get a minute. :pray:

Sam: :eyes: I’ll review within the hour.

Alex: :+1: I’ll skim after lunch and flag anything blocking.

Ryan: Thanks — I'll pick this up for the 16:00 window and call it out in the merge-custody channel before I hit merge. :shipit:
